measured_blocker: Target-aware selection of five exact source heads reaches only 0.980645 mean cosine and 0.196475 relative RMSE against exact attention, while all 32 heads are selected somewhere. Pattern deletion is invalid at the active budget.

candidate.attention_representation: Shared source-weight rank-256 input factor for the complete Q/K/V projection plus shared rank-256 output factor for the complete O projection

decision: The rank-256/rank-256 shared factorization is the single source-aligned all-pattern attention candidate that leaves room for a width-560 nonlinear path and a 32-way router while remaining below the existing per-layer and 32-layer projection envelopes. Authorize one read-only source-weight factorization oracle at layer 1. Exact source MLP may be used only as a diagnostic after the compressed attention. No rank, allocation, data, source, seed, or gate sweep is authorized.
claim_boundary: No-model architecture and exact arithmetic review only; no factorization energy, attention quality, residual realization, runtime, autonomous, complete-model, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
